_comment: Hand-curated milestones. Every date was checked against the linked en.wikipedia.org article (see 'src'). Entries are original one-line summaries. Edit freely; scripts/build_history_data.py merges this file into app/data/history_themed.json.

entries.t: The first message is sent over ARPANET, from UCLA to SRI. It gets as far as 'lo' before the system crashes.
ARPANET switches to TCP/IP, the protocol suite the modern Internet still runs on.
Douglas Engelbart demos the mouse, hypertext and video conferencing in 'The Mother of All Demos.'
Tim Berners-Lee submits his proposal for what becomes the World Wide Web to CERN.
The world's first website, info.cern.ch, is published.
Tim Berners-Lee posts a summary of the World Wide Web project to a newsgroup, inviting others to join in.
CERN puts the World Wide Web software into the public domain, free for anyone to use.
Intel announces the 4004, the first commercial microprocessor.
Michael Hart types up the Declaration of Independence, the first text of Project Gutenberg's free ebook library.
Apple is founded by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne.
IBM introduces the IBM Personal Computer.
Apple introduces the original Macintosh.
Microsoft releases Windows 1.0.
Linus Torvalds announces a free hobby operating system on a newsgroup. It grows into Linux.
Linux 0.01 is released publicly.
Google is incorporated.
Wikipedia goes live.
Mark Zuckerberg launches thefacebook.com.
The first video, 'Me at the zoo,' is uploaded to YouTube.
Steve Jobs announces the iPhone.
The first iPhone goes on sale in the United States.
Bitcoin's first block, the genesis block, is mined.
The Morris worm is released onto the early Internet, one of the first worms to spread widely.
OpenAI releases ChatGPT.
OpenAI releases GPT-4.
AlphaGo wins its match against Go champion Lee Sedol, 4 games to 1.
Around this date the Dartmouth workshop begins, widely considered the birth of artificial intelligence as a field.
The first SMS text message is sent. It reads 'Merry Christmas.'
Atari's Pong arcade game is released in North America.
Pac-Man is released in Japan.
Super Mario Bros. is released in Japan for the Famicom.
The Legend of Zelda is released in Japan.
Nintendo's Game Boy goes on sale in Japan.
Sega's Mega Drive, known as the Genesis in North America, launches in Japan.
The Super Famicom, known as the Super NES elsewhere, launches in Japan.
Sonic the Hedgehog is released in Japan.
id Software releases Doom.
Sony's original PlayStation launches in Japan.
Pokemon Red and Green are released in Japan.
Super Mario 64 is released in Japan.
Final Fantasy VII is released in Japan.
Valve releases Half-Life.
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is released in Japan.
Grand Theft Auto III is released in North America.
Halo: Combat Evolved is released in North America for the original Xbox.
Valve launches the Steam platform.
Half-Life 2 is released.
World of Warcraft launches in North America.
Xbox 360 launches in North America.
Nintendo's Wii launches in North America.
Portal is released as part of Valve's The Orange Box.
The first public alpha of Minecraft is released.
Minecraft 1.0, the game's full release, is launched.
The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim is released.
The Last of Us is released for PlayStation 3.
Grand Theft Auto V is released for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360.
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is released.
Pokemon Go launches.
The Nintendo Switch launches worldwide.
Red Dead Redemption 2 is released.
Cyberpunk 2077 is released.
Elden Ring is released.
Baldur's Gate 3 has its full release on PC.
The Jazz Singer premieres, the first feature-length film with synchronized dialogue.
Walt Disney's Steamboat Willie premieres in New York, the first fully synchronized sound cartoon.
Disneyland opens in Anaheim, California.
Doctor Who airs its first episode on the BBC.
Star Trek premieres on NBC.
Dr. No premieres in the UK, the first James Bond film.
The Beatles release Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band in the UK.
The Woodstock festival opens in upstate New York.
Walt Disney World's Magic Kingdom opens in Florida.
Jaws is released, often called the first summer blockbuster.
Star Wars opens in theaters.
MTV launches, with 'Video Killed the Radio Star' by the Buggles as its first video.
E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial is released.
Michael Jackson's Thriller is released.
The Live Aid concerts are held in London and Philadelphia.
The Simpsons premieres on Fox.
Nirvana releases Nevermind.
Jurassic Park is released.
Friends premieres on NBC.
Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated feature film, is released.
The Matrix is released.
Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone opens in the UK and US.
The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring opens in the US.
The Dark Knight is released.
Avatar opens in the US.
Marvel's The Avengers is released in the US.
